ICS 65.100.99FAD 01Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of test for warfarin bait concentrates used in the preparation of rodent baits.2. REFERENCESThe standards given below contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards:IS 460 (Part 1) : 2020 Test sieves - Specification: Part 1 Wire cloth test sieves (fourth revision)IS 1070 : 2023 Reagent grade water - Specification (fourth revision)IS 5552 : 2022 Warfarin, technical - Specification (first revision)IS 8190 (Part 1) :1988 Requirements for packaging of pesticides: Part 1 Solid pesticides (second revision)IS 10627 : 1983 Methods for sampling of pesticidal formulations
